Name: GitHub Insights
Description: Surface GitHub repo insights on your Stream Deck: live pull request, issue and notification counts, and CI status, powered by the local gh CLI.

com.benwyrosdick.github.pr-count.Name: PR Count
com.benwyrosdick.github.pr-count.Tooltip: Shows a live count of pull requests matching a filter. Press to open the search on GitHub.

com.benwyrosdick.github.issue-count.Name: Issue Count
com.benwyrosdick.github.issue-count.Tooltip: Shows a live count of issues matching a filter. Press to open the search on GitHub.

com.benwyrosdick.github.ci-status.Name: CI Status
com.benwyrosdick.github.ci-status.Tooltip: Shows the status of the latest GitHub Actions run. Press to open the run on GitHub.

com.benwyrosdick.github.notification-cou.Name: Notification Count
com.benwyrosdick.github.notification-cou.Tooltip: Shows a live count of unread GitHub notifications. Press to open your inbox.
